rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something complex, intricate, or difficult to follow.

example.english: The content of this report is too convoluted; I still do not understand it after reading it several times.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅內容太複雜，我睇咗幾次都係唔明。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 noi6 jung4 taai3 fuk1 zaap6 ngo5 tai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 dou1 hai6 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use this when the main point is that an explanation or argument is hard to understand, rather than simply complex.

example.english: The theory he explained was so convoluted that I still did not know what he was trying to say.
example.traditional: 佢講嗰套理論太難明，聽完我都唔知佢想表達乜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 go2 tou3 lei5 leon6 taai3 naan4 ming4 teng1 jyun4 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 mat1
